claims: n-268-candidate.yaml is a packing.squares:Witness/v2 file (corners, rational scalars, 268 squares) whose exact rational side, rounded up at 12 places, #928 prints as the bound. Its exact coordinates were produced by this repository's packing-witness promote --strategy robust-rational at 19b354a5 from the lab's decimal pose: pairs separated by at least about 2e-13, and squares at the walls touching them exactly. An upper bound only: no KKT, local-optimality, rigidity or global-optimality claim.

n268-witness.json is the same file as JSON. packing-witness-verify.txt is the author's run of this repository's packing-witness verify at 19b354a5 on the witness placed under packing/witnesses/known-best/ (VERIFIED, exact-algebraic, 35778 pairs); sqcheck-output.txt is the author's run of verifier/sqcheck.py, an exact checker the source says was written separately from this repository's code (VALID, exact rational, the exact side rounded up at 15 places). Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.

The issue and README say the packing starts from the registry's current 268 packing, taken from this repository's regularized known-best atlas, and was found by basin hopping over local minima computed by Evan Daniel's ALM+SLP quench (evand/square-packing search/packer at bb4cc78e, MIT), compiled into the lab's search; they ask that the improvement be credited to Doğa Özden, the base packing to its holders as the record lists them, and the local optimizer to Evan Daniel. The issue says the search was AI-assisted throughout and that the checks were run by code that did not produce the packing; the issue and repository were prepared and posted by Özden's AI agent, which uses the account kenaznia-doga; Özden directed the work.
